rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the sound made by a car horn.

example.english: The car in front kept making a honk, so I couldn't even hear my phone.
example.traditional: 前面架車不停咁響喇叭聲，搞到我都聽唔到電話。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 gaa3 ce1 bat1 ting4 gam3 hoeng2 laa3 baa1 sing1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 teng1 m4 dou3 din6 waa2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone uses a car horn.

example.english: When I see traffic backed up ahead, I honk the horn to ask the car in front to move forward a bit.
example.traditional: 見到前面塞車，我就撳喇叭叫前面架車行開啲。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 cin4 min6 sak1 ce1 ngo5 zau6 gam6 laa3 baa1 giu3 cin4 min6 gaa3 ce1 haang4 hoi1 di1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the cry of a goose or a similar bird.

example.english: The geese by the lake let out a honk together and frightened the child.
example.traditional: 湖邊啲鵝一齊發出鵝叫聲，嚇親個細路。
example.jyutping: wu4 bin1 di1 ngo4 jat1 cai4 faat3 ceot1 ngo4 giu3 seng1 haak3 can1 go3 sai3 lou6

rows.note: Use this when a person, animal, or object makes a loud honking or beeping sound.

example.english: The old motorbike starts to honk as soon as it starts, and it is so noisy I cannot sleep.
example.traditional: 架舊電單車一開着就嘟嘟叫，嘈到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: gaa3 gau6 din6 daan1 ce1 jat1 hoi1 zoek6 zau6 dou1 dou1 giu3 cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: With a goose as the subject, this means making its characteristic honking sound rather than calling out to someone.

example.english: That goose starts to honk whenever it sees a stranger.
example.traditional: 嗰隻鵝一見到陌生人就叫。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 ngo4 jat1 gin3 dou2 mak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 giu3
